# Search the Earthquake Database

Information
This form makes available seismic bulletin data from the [National Earthquake Database (NEDB)](https://earthquakescanada.nrcan.gc.ca/stndon/NEDB-BNDS/index-en.php) since 1985. As some parameters like focal depth are poorly known for most earthquakes, they are often specified only as nominal or default values. # Earthquakes in Canada

Earthquakes in Canada Historical earthquakes recorded by Earthquakes Canada. This serie is composed of 4 earthquake datasets.
